summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Synaptra Studio. All backend APIs pass (17/17 tests). Frontend navigation, Dashboard, Task Runner, and Eval pages all working correctly. The P0 bug from iteration_3 was a FALSE POSITIVE - the previous test was using wrong selector '[data-testid^="task-"]' which matched the page container. Correct selector is '.space-y-1 > div[data-testid^="task-"]' for task items.

Backend: /api/eval/runs returns run history
Backend: /api/memory and /api/memory/stats work correctly
Backend: /api/settings GET and PUT work correctly

Frontend: Dashboard loads with all sections (hero, quick actions, latency, multimodal zones, recent sessions)

Frontend: Task Runner displays task list in sidebar

Frontend: Task Runner - clicking task shows metrics (Quality, Relevance, Efficiency, Overall)
